rules.yaml_help: With a state or attribute source, the Alert Manager comparison is required and condition_template remains optional. The state_variation and attribute_variation sources compare current_value - starting_value and require condition_template: the reference is captured when that template becomes true, then reset when it becomes false. attribute_variation also requires one numeric attribute without wildcards. Variations accept above, below, between and outside. The between and outside operators use value: [lower_bound, upper_bound]; unchanged has no value. An attribute path such as data.*.key checks every array item for regular comparisons. With source: unchanged, state and attributes are monitored together. With source: jinja, only condition_template is evaluated and it is required. update_message_when_active keeps recalculating a Jinja message after activation.
